ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central region; continuous low-intensity black perimeter bands along trailing and leading edges; vertical dark patch at the median notch; four distinct dark diagonal parallel bands on the proximal left lobe; two elongated dark linear features on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits three distinct low-frequency, high-amplitude jagged notches with pixel amplitudes exceeding 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lunate morphology with concave leading edges and convex-trending trailing edges; sweep trajectory angled approximately 30 degrees upward from the horizontal median notch axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized, high-contrast white circular spots (3-6 pixel diameter) primarily concentrated along the black trailing edge margins and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple thin, dark linear pixel disruptions; a group of four parallel diagonal streaks on the left lobe and one prominent elongated vertical-diagonal line on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged tissue irregularities and missing segments along the right trailing edge; elongated vertical linear scar on the right lobe mid-section.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique four-bar pigmentation pattern on the inner mid-section of the left lobe proximally located relative to the central notch.
